data.title: Atlas: Purpose意味差の責任Scopeを既存Worldへ投影
data.body:
Purposeの意味差として宣言された責任Scopeを、既存のAtlasWorldへ **Purpose / Scopes / Agents の三つの領域**で投影します。現状更新後の残差は同じ画面で読めます。

Goal: Purposeから必要な意味差（Scope）と担当を三つの領域で辿り、現状更新後の残差を同じ画面で読める。

Refs #68 (existing Closure reducer; PR #69). Related: roccho-dev/adrs#613 (requirement), roccho-dev/ui#344 (consumer; Draft).

## Scope

Draft, open, unmerged. Published head `b1fec7a61a0f7728f6262c70afc591f5661f8dd3`, tree `d7f7c6d282557a39cf7a0dc5e67e7c5b0d0dc3ca`, one normal commit on `88403ce`. The tree equals the reviewed native commit `1386b9e`, authored by the same OCI Opus W.

On top of the preserved `88403ce` baseline (the declared semantic-scope contract and its port), exactly three `packages/atlas` paths change: `semantic-scope-world.mjs`, `tests/semantic-scope-world.test.mjs` and `README.md`. The UI consumer is unchanged at `ccd05d0`.

The World has exactly three areas:

- **Purpose:** the Purpose, the target role, and one **Current** per frame. The Current keeps one identity and shows that frame's revision. The original comparison, the frame closure and the verbatim seven-kind Closure rows stay readable as history in the target→Purpose relation.
- **Scopes:** the Gap is shown only through responsibility units.
  - Current needed change: `active` Scopes, explicit **unassigned** units (unowned parts or residuals), and explicit unknown/conflict units.
  - Not current need: `completed-history` Scopes (satisfied, mapping bound), kept as checkpoints, and old obligations kept as history.
  - `unresolved` Scopes keep their satisfied evidence readable while the mapping is unknown. They are neither current need nor history.
  - A Scope's status comes only from its own criteria. A disagreement with the whole-Purpose evaluation shows as `conflict`, with both declarations kept.
  - The current Gap is never empty unless the Purpose is declared satisfied.
  - `coverage.unknown` counts only unassigned and unknown/conflict units and Scopes whose own status is unknown/conflict or whose standing is unresolved. A known, owned, unmet Scope is in the Gap but is not unknown.
- **Agents:** only the declared ids (Scope `owner_actor`, observation `writer`/`evaluator`) with their declared roles, labelled synthetic, declared-only and activity-unobserved. Unassigned units have no Agent. A missing declaration is shown explicitly.

Overview captions are two short lines. Every full label, id, revision and status stays in the record. The two observation writer/evaluator relations would cross the Scopes pane, so they alone carry `visible:false`; their contexts are unchanged. The UI reports them as "Omitted relations 2", and they can be found through search and opened in the Record. Owner and Current→Scope→Target→Purpose relations stay drawn.

With the bundled synthetic fixture: in Before, `scope.delivery` is active/unmet. In After, it is a completed checkpoint, the regressed `criterion.recovery` is an unassigned unit, and the Purpose stays unmet.

## Non-scope

- No change to `semantic-scopes.mjs` (the contract), `closure.mjs`, `reduce.mjs`, the fixtures, the old Closure/semantic contract tests, workflows, the global voice-ui UI pin, or any UI repository source or test.
- No admission of the semantic contract. No domain truth or business Purpose achievement. The supplied meaning stays candidate / declared-not-verified.
- No real Agent collection or activity. No Hot/Cold/SSE or Factory work.
- No merge, Issue close or deploy.

## Verification

Independent R replay of tree `d7f7c6d` (OCI, Node 24.18, declared Playwright 1.60 / Chromium 1223):

- `node --test packages/atlas/tests/*.test.mjs`: **148/148**, 0 fail. The tests pin the three areas, Current revisions, Scope standings, the current Gap, the exact `coverage.unknown` value and units for 12 cases, declared-only Agents, the two omitted relations' exact contexts, and Direction.
- World from the unchanged fixtures: sha256 `3369271a…`. HTML from the unchanged UI `ccd05d0` builder: sha256 `6bff9621…`.
- Unchanged UI search proof: **15/15**.
- Chromium at 1280×720 and 1500×1000, in Before, in After and after reload: 0 overlapping or blank captions, exactly 2 omitted relations (each found by search and shown in the Record), and 0 browser errors.

Public source (read back by R from P's connector snapshot): head `b1fec7a` has single parent `88403ce` and tree `d7f7c6d`. Its 3 changed blobs (`b926d416`, `275050e7`, `8259d588`; mode 100644) equal those of the accepted native commit.

CI on `b1fec7a` (P connector snapshot, 2026-10-14T13:52:26Z; read back by R): [nix-check / flake-check](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/actions/runs/38572579351/job/115881332878) is the only check run on the head. It completed with **success**, and all 8 steps passed, including step 4 "Check Atlas Purpose Closure" and step 5 "Run flake check". The run reports one annotation whose text is not in the snapshot.

P final Japanese screen (actual Windows browser, 1280×720, same HTML `6bff9621…`; read back by R): **PASS**.
- Three areas and one Current, which reads `current-before@1` in Before and `post-observation@2` in After.
- Japanese glyph ink sits inside the nodes, with no blank or colliding captions. The 2 px line-box overrun is whitespace, not clipped glyphs.
- Search for `criterion.recovery` gives 0 results in Before and 5 in After.
- The Record of `scope:scope.delivery` shows owner, criteria, evidence and residual.
- A zero-result query keeps the selection.
- Both omitted relations ("Omitted relations 2") are recoverable through search and the Record.
- The unassigned unit's Direction reaches the Purpose.
- Reload keeps the selection, and the browser error log is empty.

## Merge condition

- R completes the final series readback of this published body.
- Explicit human approval.

Do not merge automatically. Merging requires explicit human approval; this Draft grants none.
